sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about the service, your account or this notice, contact us exclusively by email at {{contactEmail}}. We do not handle commercial or support requests by postal mail.

sections.title: Nature of the service
sections.body: Stack32 is an online digital service (SaaS) that lets you create, configure and use AI agents. Access to the service, allocation of usage credits and paid features are activated immediately after payment confirmation.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All elements of the Stack32 service (structure, texts, visuals, logos, code, trademarks) are protected by intellectual-property law and remain the exclusive property of {{companyName}} or its licensors. Any reproduction, representation, adaptation or exploitation, in whole or in part, without prior written authorization is prohibited.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: This notice and the Stack32 service are governed by French law.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms of use ("Terms") govern access to and use of the Stack32 service, published by {{companyName}}. By creating an account, using Stack32 or subscribing, you accept these Terms, the Subscription & Sales Terms, and the Refund Policy without reservation.

sections.title: 1. The service
sections.body: Stack32 lets you create, test and use AI agents by describing them in natural language. The service includes a builder interface, a live chat with your agents, and a structure view of their configuration. Stack32 is provided as a web application accessible with a compatible browser. As soon as a paid subscription is activated, usage credits may be granted and Pro features become available immediately.

sections.title: 2. Account
sections.body: You must create an account to use the product. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity performed through your account. You must provide accurate information and be at least 15 years old, or have parental consent.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree not to use Stack32 to generate or spread illegal, harmful or misleading content; not to attempt to bypass technical limits or security measures; not to infringe third-party rights; and not to resell the service without authorization. We may suspend accounts that violate these rules.

sections.title: 4. AI-generated content
sections.body: Agents produce content automatically. Despite automated testing, results may be incomplete, inaccurate or inappropriate for your use case. You remain responsible for reviewing and using agent outputs. Stack32 does not guarantee the accuracy of generated content.

sections.title: 5. Your content
sections.body: You retain ownership of the content you submit (prompts, documents, knowledge sources). You grant {{companyName}} the licenses strictly necessary to operate the service, including processing your content through third-party AI model providers.

sections.title: 6. Subscriptions, immediate performance and non-refundability
sections.body: Some features require a paid subscription. Prices, billing, withdrawal rights and cancellation are described in the Subscription & Sales Terms and the Refund Policy. By subscribing and ticking the mandatory checkout boxes, you request immediate performance of the digital service (subscription activation, servers, Builder credits, agent-building capacity) and expressly waive your withdrawal right (French Consumer Code arts. L221-18 and L221-28; Directive 2011/83/EU art. 16). Started periods are non-refundable, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 7. Availability
sections.body: We strive to keep Stack32 available and reliable, but the service is provided "as is", without guarantee of uninterrupted availability. We may modify or discontinue features with reasonable notice.

sections.title: 8. Liability
sections.body: To the extent permitted by law, {{companyName}}'s liability is limited to the amounts you paid for the service during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law.

sections.title: 9. Termination
sections.body: You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. Cancellation of a paid subscription follows the Subscription & Sales Terms (end of the current period, no refund of amounts already paid). We may suspend or terminate accounts in case of breach of these terms, with notice where reasonably possible.

sections.title: 10. Governing law and disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. In case of dispute, first contact us at {{contactEmail}}. Failing an amicable agreement, the competent French courts shall have jurisdiction. If you are a consumer, you may also use consumer mediation under the French Consumer Code.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {{companyName}} collects through Stack32, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.body: The data controller is {{companyName}} (SIREN {{siren}}, {{rcs}}). Contact: {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
sections.body: Account data (email, name, password hash); profile data provided during onboarding (first name, phone number, role, discovery source, use case); content you submit (prompts, conversations, documents); usage data (features used, technical logs); and billing data processed by our payment provider.

sections.title: 3. Why we process it
sections.body: To provide the service (create and run your agents), to secure accounts, to improve the product, to provide support, to handle billing, and to comply with legal obligations. Legal bases include contract performance, legitimate interest, legal obligations, and consent for optional analytics and advertising cookies.

sections.title: 4. AI processing
sections.body: Your prompts and connected documents are processed by AI model providers acting as processors, strictly to generate your agents' answers. We do not use your private content to train our own models.

sections.title: 5. Sharing
sections.body: Data is shared only with processors necessary to run the service (IONOS hosting, database, AI model providers, payment provider) and, if you consent, analytics (PostHog) or advertising partners (Meta, TikTok), under data-processing or platform terms. We do not sell personal data for money. Advertising pixels can count as “sharing” under some US laws — see section 11.

sections.title: 6. Retention
sections.body: Account data is kept while your account is active, then deleted or anonymized within the legal limitation periods. You can request deletion at any time.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (French supervisory authority). To exercise your rights, contact {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption in transit, access controls, isolation of customer data and least-privilege access.

sections.title: 9. Transfers outside the EU
sections.body: Some processors may be located outside the European Union. In that case, transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: 10. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies (session, security, language, theme, consent record) run without extra consent because the service cannot work without them. Analytics (PostHog, including session replay with form fields masked) and advertising pixels (Meta, TikTok) load only after you accept them in the cookie banner. You can accept all, reject all, or customise categories, and change your mind at any time from the footer or the cookie policy. See the Cookie policy for the full list.

sections.title: 11. Rights in the United States (CCPA/CPRA)
sections.body: If you are a California resident (and, where applicable, a resident of other US states with similar laws), you may request access, correction, deletion, and information about data we collected. We do not sell personal information for money. Advertising pixels, if you enable them, can qualify as “sharing” for cross-context behavioural advertising. Use “Do not sell or share my data” in the footer, or reject marketing cookies, to opt out. We honour Global Privacy Control (GPC) as an opt-out of advertising cookies. To exercise other rights, contact {{contactEmail}}.

sections.title: 12. Rights in Canada (PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25)
sections.body: If you are in Canada, you may request access, correction, and withdrawal of consent for optional processing, and you may complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada or, in Quebec, the Commission d’accès à l’information. Optional analytics and advertising cookies are off until you opt in. To exercise your rights, contact {{contactEmail}}.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This policy describes the cookies and similar technologies used by Stack32, how to accept, refuse or customise them, and how that choice is stored. It complements the Privacy policy.

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored on your device by your browser. Similar technologies include local storage, pixels and scripts that read a device identifier. They can be strictly necessary to run the service, or used for measurement and advertising — in which case we ask for your consent first.

sections.title: 2. Your choices (EU/France, UK, US, Canada)
sections.body: A banner lets you accept all optional cookies, reject all optional cookies, or customise categories. Accept and reject are equally available. Until you choose, analytics and advertising stay off. Your choice is stored for 13 months (CNIL), then we ask again. You can reopen the panel from “Cookie settings” in the footer, from this page, or via “Do not sell or share my data” (US). A Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal is treated as a refusal of advertising cookies.

sections.title: 3. Strictly necessary cookies
sections.body: These do not require consent: stack32.locale (language, 12 months), stack32.theme (appearance, 12 months), stack32_consent (your cookie choice, 13 months), Supabase authentication cookies (signed-in session and security), and technical cookies set by hCaptcha on sign-up when that protection is enabled. Blocking them may prevent login or security checks from working.

sections.title: 4. Analytics cookies (optional)
sections.body: If you accept analytics, we load PostHog (US cloud ingest at us.i.posthog.com, acting as our processor under a data-processing agreement / standard contractual clauses) to measure page views, product usage and session replay. Form fields are masked in replay. Typical cookies include ph_* / distinct_id identifiers, with a lifetime up to 12 months. These scripts do not load if you refuse analytics, if no PostHog key is configured, or after you withdraw consent.

sections.title: 5. Advertising cookies (optional)
sections.body: If you accept marketing, we may load the Meta (Facebook) Pixel and the TikTok Pixel to measure campaigns and, where those platforms allow, retargeting. Typical cookies include _fbp, _fbc (Meta, up to 90 days) and _ttp / _tt_enable_cookie (TikTok, up to 13 months). These partners may process data in the United States. They do not load if you refuse marketing, if no pixel ID is configured, if your browser sends GPC, or after you withdraw consent.

sections.title: 6. Local storage
sections.body: Stack32 uses your browser’s local storage to remember language and theme, and, in development/mock mode, to store demo data on your device. PostHog may also use local storage when analytics is accepted.

sections.title: 7. Processors and transfers
sections.body: Necessary hosting and authentication: IONOS and Supabase. Optional analytics: PostHog (US ingest). Optional advertising: Meta Platforms and TikTok, only if those pixels are configured and you consent. Transfers outside the EU rely on appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: 8. How to change or delete cookies
sections.body: Use Cookie settings on this site to change analytics or marketing. You can also delete cookies and local storage in your browser. Withdrawing consent stops new collection; it does not always erase copies already held by an advertising platform — you can also opt out in your Meta / TikTok account settings. Contact {{contactEmail}} for access or deletion requests.

sales.title: Subscription & sales terms
sales.intro: These terms apply to paid subscriptions to Stack32, sold by {{companyName}}. They complement the Terms of use and the Refund Policy.

sections.title: 1. Offer and nature of the service
sections.body: Stack32 is offered as a subscription giving immediate access to a digital service (digital content / electronically supplied service): subscription activation, provisioning of the required server resources, possible allocation of usage (Builder) credits, and the ability to create and run agents as soon as payment is confirmed. These elements are consumed or provisioned immediately and cannot be “restocked” like a physical good. Features and limits of each plan are described at purchase and on the pricing page.

sections.title: 2. Price and payment
sections.body: Prices are shown in the checkout flow, taxes indicated where applicable. Payment is processed by our payment provider. The subscription renews automatically each period until canceled. Payment for a period is a firm order for that period.

sections.title: 3. Immediate performance
sections.body: As soon as payment is confirmed, {{companyName}} immediately performs the service: subscription activation, provisioning / unlocking of servers and paid features, and where applicable immediate crediting of your usage balance. You may use the service without waiting for the legal withdrawal period to expire. This immediate performance is why no refund is available once the period has started.

sections.title: 4. Right of withdrawal — express waiver (French Consumer Code)
sections.body: Under articles L221-18 et seq. of the French Consumer Code, consumers generally have fourteen (14) days to withdraw from a distance contract. However, article L221-28 provides in particular that the withdrawal right cannot be exercised for: (i) the supply of digital content not supplied on a tangible medium where performance has begun with the consumer's prior express consent and express waiver of the withdrawal right; (ii) service contracts fully performed before the end of the withdrawal period where performance began with the consumer's prior express consent and express waiver. These rules transpose Directive 2011/83/EU (art. 16). By ticking the checkout box and confirming your order, you (a) expressly request that performance begin immediately, (b) acknowledge that the service (access, servers, credits, agent-building capacity) is provided without delay, and (c) expressly waive your withdrawal right. Accordingly, no refund is due under withdrawal for the started period.

sections.title: 5. No refunds for started periods
sections.body: Unless mandatory law provides otherwise, {{companyName}} will not refund amounts already paid for a started subscription period, including early cancellation, non-use, change of mind, or partial use of credits. The Refund Policy details this principle and the very limited exceptions (billing error, major failure attributable to Stack32).

sections.title: 5 bis. International and United States law
sections.body: For customers outside France / the EU, Stack32 is likewise sold as a digital service performed immediately. In the United States, the FTC Cooling-Off Rule (16 C.F.R. Part 429) generally does not apply to online distance sales of software / digital services of this kind; unless mandatory local law provides otherwise, started subscription periods are non-refundable. You accept these terms by ticking the mandatory checkboxes at checkout.

sections.title: 6. Cancellation
sections.body: You may cancel at any time from your billing settings or by contacting {{contactEmail}}. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period: the service and charges continue until the last day of that period, then stop. Cancellation does not give rise to any refund of amounts already collected for the current period, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 7. Price changes
sections.body: We may change prices with at least 30 days' notice. Changes apply from the next renewal. If you disagree, you can cancel before the new price takes effect.

sections.title: 8. Fair use
sections.body: Usage limits (number of agents, runs, knowledge volume, credits) are described per plan. We may throttle abusive usage that threatens platform stability, with notice where possible.

sections.title: 9. Consents collected at checkout
sections.body: Before any payment, you must clearly tick: (1) acceptance of the Terms of use (and related documents, including the refund policy); (2) your request for immediate performance and your express waiver of the withdrawal right. Without these consents, the order cannot be validated.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: This policy sets out the refund rules for Stack32 subscriptions sold by {{companyName}}. It applies to every paid subscription order and complements the Subscription & Sales Terms.

sections.title: 1. Principle: no refunds
sections.body: Stack32 subscriptions are digital services performed immediately. Upon payment, the subscription is activated, the required servers / resources are provisioned, usage credits may be granted, and you can create and use agents without delay. These services cannot be undone afterwards like an unopened physical good. Therefore, unless mandatory law provides otherwise, no amount already paid for a started period is refundable — including if you did not use the service, changed your mind, cancel mid-period, or used only part of your credits.

sections.title: 2. Legal basis (French and EU law)
sections.body: Under articles L221-18 and L221-28 of the French Consumer Code (transposing Directive 2011/83/EU, art. 16), the 14-day withdrawal right does not apply when you have expressly requested immediate performance of digital content / an electronically supplied service and expressly waived that right before performance began. These consents are collected via mandatory checkboxes in the checkout flow. As Stack32 is a digital service not supplied on a tangible medium, the waiver is enforceable under the conditions set by law.

sections.title: 2 bis. United States and other jurisdictions
sections.body: In the United States, the FTC federal cooling-off rule generally does not cover this type of online SaaS subscription. Unless mandatory local law provides otherwise, started periods are non-refundable. In all jurisdictions, payment constitutes acceptance of immediate performance and of the absence of refunds for the started period, subject to mandatory statutory rights.

sections.title: 3. What payment covers
sections.body: Your payment covers immediate access to the service for the subscribed period: plan features, server provisioning, capacity to build and run agents, and where applicable the immediate crediting of your usage balance. These elements constitute performance of the service as soon as payment is confirmed and explain why refunds are not available.

sections.title: 4. Cancellation ≠ refund
sections.body: You may cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation ends automatic renewal at the end of the current period. It is not a refund request: you keep access until the end of the period already paid, and no pro-rata is paid for unused days, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

sections.title: 5. Limited exceptions
sections.body: We will examine in good faith: (a) duplicate or clearly erroneous charges, refunded in full after verification; (b) a major service outage attributable to Stack32 that prevented you from using the service for a significant part of the period, which may result in a credit or pro-rata refund at our reasonable discretion. Temporary glitches, user error, unsatisfactory agent output, or a change of mind are not grounds for a refund.

sections.title: 6. How to contact us
sections.body: For any billing request, write to {{contactEmail}} with the account email and invoice reference. We reply within 7 business days. Any eventual refund is issued to the original payment method via our payment provider.

sections.title: 7. Mandatory statutory rights
sections.body: Nothing in this policy limits mandatory statutory rights you may have as a consumer, including legal guarantees applicable to digital services where the law so requires.
